title: The Thornwood Lodge
objective: Get into Captain Hesk's lodge or the Wolfstone above it, take what you can of the deserters' plunder, and leave the Thornwood alive.

entries.omen: Claws skitter across the yard, and a loose mastiff noses out of the dark.
The bear rattles its chain in the hall.
A hound bays somewhere behind the palisade.
Wolves howl on the crag, nearer than before.
Wind moans through the broken gatehouse.
A sheep bell clanks far down the drove road.

rooms.name: Forest Gate
rooms.description: A sagging gate in the lodge's palisade, where a charcoal-burner has made camp beside a woodpile. The hunt ride climbs east through the thorn towards the Wolfstone.

features.name: Woodpile
features.description: Split logs stacked against the palisade.
features.discovery: Behind the logs are a stoppered vial of red liquid, a shuttered lantern and a small oilskin pouch.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Hooded Lantern
items.description: A shuttered lantern with a wire handle.

items.name: Pearl in an Oilskin Pouch
items.description: A pearl the size of a thumbnail, cool and faintly luminous, tied up in a scrap of oilskin.

creatures.name: Brann the Charcoal-burner
creatures.description: A soot-black charcoal-burner with a pack of goods to sell.

topics.name: the lodge
topics.reply: "Captain Hesk took the king's lodge when he quit the war. His hound runs the kennel yard, and a bear baits in the hall. Hesk feeds it from the kitchen, or it would have had him by now."

topics.name: the poachers' path
topics.reply: "Round the palisade to the left, there's a poachers' hide. They left in a hurry."

rooms.name: Poachers' Hide
rooms.description: A hide of woven branches under the palisade, smelling of old smoke.

features.name: Poachers' Cache
features.description: A sack hung from a branch, out of reach of foxes.
features.discovery: In the sack are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a pair of iron tongs.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Trapper's Tongs
items.description: Long iron tongs for springing traps.

rooms.name: Kennel Yard
rooms.description: A muddy yard ringed with kennels and strewn with gnawed antlers. The hall door is nailed shut; a low door leads to the kitchen, and a gate to the falconer's mews.

features.name: Hound's Kennel
features.description: The largest kennel, its straw matted flat.
features.discovery: Under the straw are a gilt hunting cup and a purse of gold.

items.name: Gilt Hunting Cup
items.description: A cup of gilt bronze chased with running deer.

items.name: Purse of Gold
items.description: A purse of gold pieces.

rooms.name: Falconer's Mews
rooms.description: A whitewashed mews of empty perches, quiet and dry. Its door bars from inside.

features.name: Perches
features.description: Bare perches crusted with old mutes; the hawks are long gone.

features.name: Falconer's Bench
features.description: A bench of hoods and jesses.
features.discovery: A note in a careful hand: "The bear will let anyone by while it has meat. Hesk feeds it through the kitchen hatch."

rooms.name: Lodge Kitchen
rooms.description: A smoky kitchen, its fire banked low and its hooks hung with game. A serving hatch looks down into the hall, with a door beside it.

features.name: Larder Hooks
features.description: Iron hooks hung with game.
features.discovery: A haunch of venison hangs among the hares, and a purse is tucked behind it.

features.name: Serving Hatch
features.description: A hatch into the lodge hall, over the bear pit. Bones litter the sill.

changed.description: Below the hatch the bear tears at the haunch, deaf to everything else.

uses.text: You heave the haunch through the hatch. The bear falls on it with a roar.

items.name: Haunch of Venison
items.description: A heavy haunch of venison, half roasted.

items.name: Cook's Purse
items.description: A greasy purse of gold pieces.

rooms.name: Lodge Hall
rooms.description: A long feasting hall under a hammerbeam roof, its walls hung with antlers. A chain runs from a post to a churned-up bear pit, a hatch in the floor leads down to the ice house, and a gallery stair climbs to the captain's solar.

features.name: Bear Pit
features.description: A pit of churned earth at the end of the chain.
features.discovery: Nothing but churned earth and bones.

changed.description: The bear sprawls in its pit, tearing at the haunch, and pays you no mind.

features.name: Trophy Wall
features.description: Antlers, boar tusks and the king's old hunting shields crowd the wall.

failure-by-5.text: You tug at a shield and a rack of antlers crashes down on you.

failure.text: Dust and cobwebs, and nothing behind them you can see.

success.text: One shield bears no king's arms. Behind it, in a hollow in the wall, lies a jewel.

success-by-5.text: One shield bears no king's arms. Behind it, in a hollow in the wall, lie a jewel and a stoppered vial.

features.name: Ice-house Hatch
features.description: A heavy hatch in the hall floor, frozen shut over the ice-house steps.

failure.text: The ice holds the hatch fast.

success.text: The ice cracks and the hatch lifts onto the ice-house steps.

features.name: Bear Chain
features.description: A heavy chain from the post to the bear's collar.

failure.text: The bear drags you a step before you let go.

success.text: You haul on the chain and the bear crashes onto its side.

features.name: Hearth
features.description: A great hearth with a hunting sword hung above it.
features.discovery: The sword is a king's hanger, its blade bright under the soot.

items.name: Topaz
items.description: A golden-yellow stone.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: The King's Hanger
items.description: A short hunting sword with a faint silver sheen.

rooms.name: Ice House
rooms.description: A domed ice house, half full of straw-packed ice. Something huge has made a nest in the back.

features.name: Owlbear's Nest
features.description: A nest of straw, feathers and bones.
features.discovery: Among the bones are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a cloudy green stone.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Jade
items.description: A cloudy green stone.

rooms.name: Captain's Solar
rooms.description: A panelled room above the hall, warm from a banked fire. Captain Hesk's strongbox sits at the foot of a carved bed.

features.name: Hesk's Strongbox
features.description: An iron-bound strongbox with a broken lock.
features.discovery: Inside are a gold-chased hunting horn and a bag of gold.

items.name: Gold-chased Hunting Horn
items.description: An ivory hunting horn chased with gold, carved with the old king's hounds.

items.name: Hesk's Gold
items.description: A bag of gold pieces.

items.name: Captain Hesk's Coins
items.description: A heavy pouch of gold pieces.

rooms.name: Drovers' Camp
rooms.description: A cold camp below the hillfort's ditch, where the hunt ride comes up out of the thorn. A drover sits by a cart beside a sheepfold, and a sheep track winds up the hill behind it.

features.name: Drover's Cart
features.description: A two-wheeled cart loaded with sacks.
features.discovery: Wedged under the sacks are a stoppered vial of red liquid and an iron crowbar.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: An iron crowbar, flattened at one end.

creatures.name: Wenna the Drover
creatures.description: A weathered drover with a crook across her knees and a pack of goods to sell.

topics.name: the hillfort
topics.reply: "The Reaver took the keep when he fell out with Captain Hesk over the plunder. His wolf runs the ditch, and there's a bear in the old undercroft."

topics.name: the sheep track
topics.reply: "Up past the thorn and you'll find the old watchtower. Mind the stair."

rooms.name: Sheepfold
rooms.description: A drystone fold where the drovers pen their sheep at night, its gate hung with hurdles.

features.name: Hurdles
features.description: Woven hurdles that close the fold's gap.

rooms.name: Old Watchtower
rooms.description: A roofless tower on the hill's shoulder, looking down into the fort.

features.name: Lookout's Niche
features.description: A niche in the wall, out of the wind.
features.discovery: A coil of knotted rope and a stoppered vial of red liquid lie in the niche.

items.name: Knotted Rope
items.description: Fifty feet of hempen rope, knotted every foot.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Outer Ditch
rooms.description: A deep ditch below the rampart, littered with gnawed bones. A rusted portcullis blocks the gate passage.

features.name: Wolf's Lair
features.description: A hollow under the rampart, matted with fur.
features.discovery: Among the bones lie a drover's purse and a silver sheep bell.

features.name: Loose Rampart Stones
features.description: Facing stones hang loose at the top of the rampart.

success.text: The stones tumble down onto your foe.

items.name: Drover's Purse
items.description: A purse of gold pieces.

items.name: Silver Sheep Bell
items.description: A silver bell engraved with a running wolf.

rooms.name: Gatehouse
rooms.description: A broken gatehouse inside the rampart. A rope bridge sags across a ravine towards the keep, steps lead down into the undercroft, and a door opens into the rampart.

features.name: Rope Bridge
features.description: Frayed ropes and rotten planks over a deep ravine.

failure-by-5.text: Planks snap under you. You catch a rope and swing into the ravine wall, and the bridge falls away behind you.

failure.text: The bridge bucks and sways, and you scramble back to the gatehouse.

success.text: You cross the bridge plank by plank to the keep's door.

features.name: Guard Locker
features.description: A dented iron locker against the wall.
features.discovery: At the back of the locker is a red-veined bloodstone.

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: A dark green stone flecked with red.

rooms.name: Guardroom
rooms.description: A low guardroom in the rampart, where the Reaver's gaoler dozes over a dice table.

features.name: Dice Table
features.description: A barrel-head table strewn with cups.
features.discovery: Among the cups are a pot of winnings and a pair of ivory dice.

items.name: Dice Winnings
items.description: A pot of mixed coin.

items.name: Ivory Dice
items.description: A pair of carved ivory dice with garnet pips.

items.name: Reaver's Gaoler's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

items.name: Reaver's Gaoler's Rough Gem
items.description: A cloudy, roughly cut stone that a jeweller would buy.

rooms.name: Undercroft
rooms.description: A collapsed undercroft that stinks of bear. A stair at the far end climbs towards the keep.

features.name: Heap of Bones
features.description: Bones and rags dragged into a corner.
features.discovery: Under the rags are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a milky moonstone.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Moonstone
items.description: A milky, glowing moonstone.

rooms.name: Keep Hall
rooms.description: The hall of the old keep, hung with stolen banners. The Reaver's strongbox sits under the high table.

features.name: Reaver's Strongbox
features.description: An iron-bound strongbox under the high table.
features.discovery: Inside are a silver-gilt drinking horn and a bag of gold.

items.name: Silver-gilt Drinking Horn
items.description: A drinking horn bound in silver-gilt and carved with hunting scenes.

items.name: Reaver's Gold
items.description: A bag of gold pieces.

items.name: Reaver's Coins
items.description: A heavy pouch of gold pieces.

passages.description: The path round the palisade to the kennels.
The poachers' path round the palisade.
The serving door beside the hatch.
The steps down under the hatch.

trap.name: Man-trap
trap.description: Iron jaws hidden under the rushes on the gallery stair.
trap.trigger: Iron jaws slam shut on your leg.

passages.description: The hunt ride, climbing through the thorn to the drovers' camp under the Wolfstone.
The sheep track up the hill.
The track down into the ditch.

door.name: Rusted Portcullis
door.description: A rusted portcullis, jammed a foot off the ground.

passages.description: The steps down into the undercroft.
The rope bridge over the ravine.

opponents.name: Hesk's Hound
opponents.description: A dire wolf the size of a pony, wearing a studded war collar.

opponents.name: Baiting Bear
opponents.description: A scarred brown bear straining at a heavy chain, mad with rage.

opponents.name: Captain Hesk
opponents.description: A grey deserter captain in splint armour, a greatsword held low and steady.

opponents.name: Reaver's Wolf
opponents.description: A dire wolf the size of a pony, a spiked collar round its neck.

opponents.name: The Wolfstone Reaver
opponents.description: A scarred bandit captain in a wolfskin cloak, a scimitar in each hand.

endings.title: Out with the spoils
endings.text: You leave the Thornwood with spoils from the deserters' holds.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You leave the Thornwood with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen in the Thornwood
endings.text: You fall in the Thornwood. Your adventuring ends here.
